description: This file defines the AttachmentStore class for managing attachment-related operations such as download, recheck, rename, and delete within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for handling attachment streams, progress tracking, and integration with other stores and utilities.

classes.name: AttachmentStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage attachment operations such as download, recheck, rename, and delete, with progress tracking and stream handling.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Increments the nonce to trigger a refresh.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads multiple attachments as a ZIP stream, with progress updates and cancellation support.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing download operation if active.

methods.name: recheck
methods.description: Rechecks the specified attachments for validity or issues, reporting progress and handling errors.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an attachment by updating its filename in the database and refreshing the store.

methods.name: permanentDelete
methods.description: Deletes an attachment permanently, updates related notes and sessions, with error handling.

methods.name: _changeWorkingStatus
methods.description: Updates the processing status of an attachment (working, failed, or none).
